properties.name: file
properties.summary:
A `File` object representing the file where this database is stored. Must only be used for
setting file properties.

properties.name: lastInsertRowId
properties.summary: The identifier of the last populated row.

properties.name: rowsAffected
properties.summary: The number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: close
methods.summary:
Closes the database and releases resources from memory. Once closed, this instance is no
longer valid and should not be used. On iOS, also closes all [Titanium.Database.ResultSet](api:Titanium.Database.ResultSet)
instances that exist.

methods.name: execute
methods.summary: Executes an SQL statement against the database and returns a `ResultSet`.

examples.title: Executing a Query

parameters.name: sql
parameters.summary: SQL to execute. May include placeholders for parameter substitution.

parameters.name: vararg
parameters.summary:
Either a variable ordered list of zero or more values, or an array of values,
to be substituted with the respective `?` placeholder of the query.

methods.name: executeAll
methods.summary:
Synchronously executes an array of SQL statements against the database and returns an array of `ResultSet`.
On failure, this will throw an [Error](api:BatchQueryError) that reports the failed index and partial results

parameters.name: queries
parameters.summary: Array of SQL queries to execute.

methods.name: executeAllAsync
methods.summary:
Asynchronously executes an array of SQL statements against the database and fires a callback with a possible Error, and an array of `ResultSet`.
On failure, this will call the callback with an [Error](api:PossibleBatchQueryError) that reports the failed `index`, and a second argument with the partial `results`.

parameters.name: queries
parameters.summary: Array of SQL queries to execute.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: Callback when query execution has completed.

inlined.name: PossibleBatchQueryError
inlined.summary:
Simple `Error` argument provided to the callback from the
[executeAllAsync](api:Titanium.Database.DB#executeAllAsync) method in case of failure

returns.summary:
On SDK 10+, this method will return a `Promise` whose resolved value is equivalent to that passed to the optional callback argument.
If the `Promise` is rejected, the `Error` will have custom properties indicating the `index` of the failed query, and the partial `results` up to that failure. See [PossibleBatchQueryError](api:PossibleBatchQueryError).

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.summary: Asynchronously executes an SQL statement against the database and fires a callback with a possible `Error` argument, and a second argument holding a possible `ResultSet`.

parameters.name: query
parameters.summary: SQL query to execute. May include placeholders for parameter substitution.

parameters.name: vararg
parameters.summary:
Either a variable ordered list of zero or more values, or an array of values,
to be substituted with the respective `?` placeholder of the query.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: Callback when query execution has completed.

returns.summary: On SDK 10+, this method will return a `Promise` whose resolved value is equivalent to that passed to the optional callback argument.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary:
Removes the database files for this instance from disk. WARNING: this is a destructive
operation and cannot be reversed. All data in the database will be lost; use with caution.
